one_line: Legendary Rajput court-poet of the Prithviraj Raso, shaped across 16th–19th century North Indian courts.

appearance.age_look: appears late 40s to early 50s, lean but sturdy, with a scholar’s posture and a traveller’s stamina
appearance.face: oval face, wheatish North Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing his jaw, thoughtful almond eyes with a calm, observant gaze, default expression a gentle half-smile as if about to recite a verse
appearance.hair: dark charcoal-brown hair, medium length to just below ears, combed back and slightly wavy, partly covered by a modest maroon Rajput-style pagri (turban) with a small golden band and a single matte brass kalgi-style knob at the front, no plume
appearance.costume: a long, knee-length angarkha-style wrap tunic in soft off-white cotton with a subtle woven border, worn over a fitted maroon cotton jama (inner robe) whose sleeves peek from the angarkha cuffs; tied at the side with a slim mustard-yellow cloth sash; loose churidar-style trousers in muted indigo reaching the ankles, gathered neatly; simple brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; a plain woollen shawl in dusty beige draped over the left shoulder and across the back, practical for court and travel; minimal jewellery—one thin gold ring on his right hand and a simple black-thread amulet at the neck partially hidden by his collar—keeps him clearly scholarly rather than martial while remaining region-appropriate to Rajput court culture of the 16th–17th century.
appearance.signature: a polished palm-length wooden writing board and rolled birch-bark manuscript tied with a red thread, held together in his left hand, with a slender reed pen tucked behind his right ear as his constant poetic tools.

ref_desc: Chand Bardai is a late-middle-aged wheatish-complexioned Rajput court-poet with a maroon turban, off-white angarkha over maroon jama, indigo churidar, beige shawl, brown mojari shoes, and a wooden writing board with manuscript and reed pen in maroon, mustard, indigo and beige tones.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character sheet of Chand Bardai: a dignified late-middle-aged Rajput court-poet with an oval wheatish face, calm almond eyes, short moustache and neat beard, dark wavy hair partly covered by a maroon Rajput turban with a small golden band and simple brass knob. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha wrapped and tied at the side over a fitted maroon jama whose sleeves show at the cuffs, loose indigo churidar trousers, and brown leather mojari shoes. A dusty beige woollen shawl is draped over his left shoulder and across his back, and he has a thin gold ring and a modest black-thread amulet at his neck. His signature props are a palm-sized wooden writing board and a rolled birch-bark manuscript tied with a red thread in his left hand, with a slender reed pen tucked behind his right ear. Show the character front, back, and a dynamic three-quarter view, clearly emphasizing his face, turban, layered angarkha and jama, churidar, shawl, footwear, and the writing board, manuscript, and reed pen, all in a palette of off-white, maroon, indigo, mustard yellow, dusty beige, and warm brown.
